info.title: Hanzo Cloud API
info.description: Generated from the live router — every operation below is a route the unified cloud binary actually serves. Tagged by product: the first path segment after /v1/.

get.summary:
getLimits echoes the World limits a plan grants, straight from the @hanzo/plans
catalog, so agents and dashboards configure themselves against the live catalog
instead of hardcoding tier numbers.
get.description:
getLimits echoes the World limits a plan grants, straight from the @hanzo/plans
catalog, so agents and dashboards configure themselves against the live catalog
instead of hardcoding tier numbers. It reports the requested plan, not the
caller's: it is a contract lookup, not an entitlement check. A catalog that
cannot be read yields the free-tier floor rather than an error.

parameters.name: plan
parameters.description:
Plan is a World plan id (world-free, world-pro, world-team,
world-enterprise). Empty resolves world-free.

get.summary:
getNews serves the merged, filtered, freshest-first news feed for the caller's
(org, project).
get.description:
getNews serves the merged, filtered, freshest-first news feed for the caller's
(org, project). It loads the pipeline (or the default), fans out to GDELT (per
keyword) + RSS (per feed) concurrently, applies the project filters, dedupes,
sorts by recency, caps the result at 50, and publishes a live refresh to the
SSE stream. A source that fails is skipped, so the feed degrades to honest
partial results rather than an error.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
Project, when given, must equal the caller's authenticated project scope;
a mismatch is refused. Omit it to read the authenticated project.

get.summary:
getPipeline reads the feed + filter configuration for the caller's (org,
project).
get.description:
getPipeline reads the feed + filter configuration for the caller's (org,
project). A project that has saved none gets the built-in world-news feeds
with default:true, so a first read is never empty.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description:
Project, when given, must equal the caller's authenticated project scope;
a mismatch is refused. Omit it to read the authenticated project.

put.summary:
putPipeline replaces the feed + filter configuration for the caller's (org,
project).
put.description:
putPipeline replaces the feed + filter configuration for the caller's (org,
project). Feed hosts are checked against the allowlist at this write boundary,
so a stored pipeline can never carry an unfetchable or hostile feed. The
stored pipeline is returned.

image.description: Image is a lead-image URL, when the upstream carried one.

lang.description: Lang is the upstream's language name, when it named one.

pubDate.description:
PubDate is RFC3339 UTC, or "" when the upstream gave no parseable date.
Items sort freshest-first and a dateless item sorts last.

source.description:
Source names the upstream the item came from: the RSS channel title, or
the GDELT article's domain.

title.description: Title is the headline; it is also the text keyword and region filters match on.

tone.description: Tone is GDELT's sentiment score as text; absent for RSS/Atom items.

apiRateLimit.description: APIRateLimit bounds REST /v1/world/* calls per minute.

maxAlerts.description: MaxAlerts bounds saved OSINT alert rules.

mcpRateLimit.description: MCPRateLimit bounds MCP calls per minute.

modelApi.description: ModelAPI reports whether the plan grants /v1/world/model and the SSE stream.

limits.description: Limits is the resolved contract; -1 on a rate limit or count means unlimited.

plan.description: Plan is the plan id the limits were resolved for.

unit.description: Unit is the unit both rate limits are expressed in.

items.description:
Items is the merged, filtered, deduped feed, freshest first, capped at 50.
Empty (never null) when no upstream answered.

feeds.description:
Feeds are the RSS/Atom feed URLs to pull. Each must be an http(s) URL whose
host is on the server's allowlist; max 64. An empty list clears the feeds.

filters.description:
Filters narrow the merged feed. Each axis is AND'd, terms within an axis are
OR'd, matching is case-insensitive substring; max 64 terms per axis.

createdAt.description: CreatedAt and UpdatedAt are RFC3339 UTC, absent on a default pipeline.

default.description: Default is true when no pipeline is stored and these are the built-in feeds.

feeds.description: Feeds are the RSS/Atom feed URLs this project pulls, all allowlisted hosts.

filters.description: Filters are the keyword/region/source narrowings applied to the merged feed.

org.description:
Org and Project are the tenant scope the pipeline belongs to, echoed from
the validated principal — never from the request.
